# Function to calculate birth weight z-score spline for each estimand 

```{r spline_4knot,echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

add_rcs_splines <- function(data, x_var, probs = c(0.1, 0.4, 0.6, 0.9)) {
 
  x_vector <- data %>% pull({{ x_var }})
  knots_4 <- quantile(x_vector, probs = probs, na.rm = TRUE)
  spline_matrix <- rcspline.eval(x_vector, knots = knots_4, inclx = TRUE)
  spline_df <- as.data.frame(spline_matrix)
  base_name <- deparse(substitute(x_var)) 
  colnames(spline_df) <- paste0(base_name, 1:ncol(spline_df))
  return(bind_cols(data, spline_df))
  
}

```

```{r  data_S1 table, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
#0. Prepare the base data frame to avoid code repetition
# 1. Prepare data and explicitly map the strata labels
data_prepared <- data_elig %>%
  filter(wk36_present == 1 | death_36wpma == 1) %>% #689
  mutate(
    death_36wpma = as.factor(death_36wpma),
    rand_gp = factor(rand_gp, levels = c("0", "1"), labels = c("Control", "Intervention")),
    
    # Replace existing strata values with your exact required labels.
    # (Adjust the left side of the assignments below if your original raw data values differ)
    ga_strata = case_when(
      ga_strata == 1 ~ "<28 weeks",
      ga_strata == 2 ~ "28-<32 weeks",
      TRUE ~ as.character(ga_strata)
    ),
    # Enforce factor levels to keep them in chronological order in the table columns
    ga_strata = factor(ga_strata, levels = c("<28 weeks", "28-<32 weeks"))
  )

# 2. Create the stratified table (<28 weeks and 28-<32 weeks)
tab_strata <- data_prepared %>%
  tbl_strata(
    strata = ga_strata,
    .tbl_fun = \(x) tbl_summary(
      x,
      include = death_36wpma,
      by = rand_gp,
      percent = "column",
      statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n}/{N} ({p}%)"), 
      label = list(death_36wpma ~ "Death by 36 weeks PMA")
    ) 
  )

# 3. Create the overall table
tab_overall <- data_prepared %>%
  tbl_summary(
    include = death_36wpma,
    by = rand_gp,
    percent = "column",
    statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n}/{N} ({p}%)"), 
    label = list(death_36wpma ~ "Death by 36 weeks PMA")
  ) %>%
  modify_spanning_header(all_stat_cols() ~ "**Overall**")

# 4. Merge them together side-by-side
data_S1_tab <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(tab_strata, tab_overall),
  tab_spanner = FALSE 
) %>%
  modify_caption("** Table 1: Neonatal mortality at 36 weeks PMA by Prematurity Strata and Treatment Group")

data_S1_tab
```

```{r Estimand_S1, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

# survival to 36.0 w PMA
#Sens analysis 1) replace all missing wiht alive 2) replace all missing with death # not performed as none missing


data_S1 <- data_elig %>%
  filter(wk36_present == 1 | death_36wpma == 1) %>%  #689
  dplyr::select(death_36wpma,rand_gp, ga_strata.f, multiple, ans.factor, Birth_weight_Z, sex, recr_hosp.factor) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(death_36wpma,rand_gp, ga_strata.f, multiple, ans.factor, Birth_weight_Z, sex) %>%
  add_rcs_splines(x_var = Birth_weight_Z, probs = c(0.1, 0.4, 0.6, 0.9))

fit_S1 <- glm(death_36wpma ~ rand_gp + multiple + ans.factor + ga_strata.f + sex +
                       Birth_weight_Z1 + Birth_weight_Z2 + Birth_weight_Z3,
              data = data_S1, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

summary_fit <- summary(fit_S1)

S1_rr_marginal <- avg_comparisons(fit_S1, variables = "rand_gp", type = "response", transform = "exp", comparison = "lnratioavg", vcov = "HC3")

#don't adjust p_value
aRR <- exp(coef(fit_S1)["rand_gp"])
#exp(coef()) transforms log-relative risks to relative risks
conf_int <- exp(confint(fit_S1, "rand_gp"))
cat("95% CI for difference:", conf_int[1], "to", conf_int[2], "\n")
raw_p_value_1 <- summary_fit$coefficients["rand_gp", "Pr(>|z|)"]
marg_RR <- round(S1_rr_marginal$estimate, 2)
marg_Lower_95_CI = S1_rr_marginal[,6]
marg_Upper_95_CI = S1_rr_marginal[,7]
p_value_1 <- S1_rr_marginal$p.value

results_1 <- data.frame(
 #Parameter = target_variable,
  estimate = round(aRR, digits = 2),
  Lower_95_CI = round(conf_int[1], digits = 2),
  Upper_95_CI = round(conf_int[2], digits = 2),
  raw_p_value = round(raw_p_value_1, digits = 3),
  marg_estimate <- marg_RR,
  marg_Lower_95_CI = round(marg_Lower_95_CI, digits = 2),
  marg_Upper_95_CI = round(marg_Upper_95_CI, digits = 2),
  p_value = round(p_value_1, digits = 3)
)


results_1 <- results_1 %>%
rename(marg_estimate = marg_estimate....marg_RR)


print(results_1)
```
<!-- The data for this estimand included the randomised participants known to survive until 36.0 weeks PMA, excluding those who were withdrawn by 36 week PMA (N = 53) . 2 were excluded due to missing outcome (death) data leaving 689 participants included in this analysis. -->

There was insufficient evidence to conclude a significant difference in the risk of survival to 36.0 weeks PMA between the intervention and the control groups (marginal adjusted risk ratio 0.581, 95% CI: 0.14 to 2.52, B-H adjusted p-value = 0.471).

# S2: Standardised weight at 36.0 w PMA (window 34.0 to <38.0 w PMA, general linear regression model)

```{r Estimand_S2, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
##weight at 36wks

#Outcomes for participants with missing data due to IE.3-IE.5 will be imputed using multiple imputation informed by
#participant’s prematurity stratum, multiple birth status 

#filter out those who died <= 36wPMA

data_S2 <- data_elig %>%
  filter(death_36wpma != 1 | is.na(death_36wpma)| !is.na(wpma36_weight_Z)) %>% #735
  dplyr::select(study_id,wpma36_weight_Z, rand_gp, ga_strata.f, multiple, ans.factor, Birth_weight_Z,  sex, recr_hosp.factor) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(rand_gp, ga_strata.f, multiple, ans.factor, Birth_weight_Z, sex, recr_hosp.factor) %>%
   add_rcs_splines(x_var = Birth_weight_Z, probs = c(0.1, 0.4, 0.6, 0.9))


res <- amelia(
  x = as.data.frame(data_S2 %>% dplyr::select(study_id, ga_strata.f, rand_gp, wpma36_weight_Z, multiple, Birth_weight_Z, sex)),
  m = 9, 
  p2s = 0, 
  idvars = "study_id", 
  noms = c("rand_gp", "ga_strata.f", "multiple") # Treats all 3 as nominal variables
)

####
all_models <- (with(res,
                    glm(wpma36_weight_Z ~ rand_gp + multiple + ans.factor + ga_strata.f + sex + recr_hosp.factor +
                                Birth_weight_Z1 + Birth_weight_Z2 + Birth_weight_Z3,
                                data = data_S2, family = gaussian(link = "identity"))))
betas <- sapply(all_models, function(mod) coef(mod))
ses <- sapply(all_models, function(mod) sqrt(diag(vcov(mod))))

#Pool by RUbin's rules
pooled_results <- mi.meld(q = t(betas), se = t(ses)) # t means transposed - rows to columns

regression_table <- data.frame(
  Estimate = round(as.vector(pooled_results$q.mi), digits = 4),
  Std.Error = round(as.vector(pooled_results$se.mi), digits = 4)
) %>%
  mutate(t_value = round(Estimate/Std.Error, digits = 4),
         p_value = round(2 * (1- pnorm(abs(t_value))), digits = 4),
         z_95 = qnorm(0.975),
         lower_bound = Estimate - (z_95 * Std.Error),
         upper_bound = Estimate + (z_95 * Std.Error),
         row.names = colnames(pooled_results$q.mi)
         )


pooled_coeffs <- as.vector(pooled_results$q.mi)
pooled_ses <- as.vector(pooled_results$se.mi)

###marginal effects

pooled_marginal_effects <- as.data.frame(avg_comparisons(all_models, vcov = "HC3"))


results_2 <- data.frame(
  estimate = round(regression_table$Estimate[2], digits = 4),
  Lower_95_CI = round(regression_table$lower_bound[2], digits = 2),
  Upper_95_CI = round(regression_table$upper_bound[2], digits = 2),
  raw_p_value = round(regression_table$p_value[2], digits = 3),
  marg_estimate <- round(pooled_marginal_effects$estimate[9], digits = 4),
  marg_Lower_95_CI = round(pooled_marginal_effects$conf.low[9], digits = 2),
  marg_Upper_95_CI = round(pooled_marginal_effects$conf.high[9], digits = 2),
  p_value = round(pooled_marginal_effects$p.value[9], digits = 3)
)


results_2 <- results_2 %>%
rename(marg_estimate = marg_estimate....round.pooled_marginal_effects.estimate.9...digits...4.)
print(results_2)

```
<!-- The data for this estimand includes all randomised participants known to survive until 36.0 weeks PMA (n = 735). 48 were missing their standardised weight Z-scores at 36.0 weeks PMA. 40 had withdrawn before 36w PMA. 7 had been discharged  to secondary hospital before 36 weeks PMA. 1 had their growth variables collected outside the 34-38 week window The weight Z-scores of these 48 participants were imputed using the Amelia package in R informed by prematurity strata and multiple birth status. 1 participant had a missing value for the birth weight Z-score and was excluded as this is a co-variate. -->

There was insufficient evidence to detect a significant difference in the means of standardised weight Z-scores at 36.0 weeks PMA between the control and intervention groups (marginal adjusted difference in means: -0.0004, 95% CI: -0.11 to 0.11, B-H adjusted p-value = 0.995).


# S3: Standardised length at 36.0 w PMA (window 34.0 to <38.0 w PMA, general linear regression model)

```{r Estimand_S3, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
##length at 36wks
##SAMPLE CODE for GLM - adjusted difference in mean with 95%CI*****

data_S3 <- data_elig %>%
  filter(death_36wpma != 1 | is.na(death_36wpma) | !is.na(wpma36_length_Z)) %>% #735
  dplyr::select(study_id,wpma36_length_Z, rand_gp, ga_strata.f, multiple, ans.factor, Birth_weight_Z, sex, recr_hosp.factor) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(rand_gp, ga_strata.f, multiple, ans.factor, Birth_weight_Z, sex, recr_hosp.factor) %>%
  add_rcs_splines(x_var = Birth_weight_Z, probs = c(0.1, 0.4, 0.6, 0.9))

res <- amelia(
  x = as.data.frame(data_S3 %>% dplyr::select(study_id, ga_strata.f, rand_gp, wpma36_length_Z, multiple, Birth_weight_Z, sex)),
  m = 9, 
  p2s = 0, 
  idvars = "study_id", 
  noms = c("rand_gp", "ga_strata.f", "multiple") # Treats all 3 as nominal variables
)

##update amelia code and growth trajectory not helpful

####
all_models <- (with(res,
                    glm(wpma36_length_Z ~ rand_gp + multiple + ans.factor + ga_strata.f + sex + recr_hosp.factor +
                                Birth_weight_Z1 + Birth_weight_Z2 + Birth_weight_Z3,
                                data = data_S3, family = gaussian(link = "identity"))))
betas <- sapply(all_models, function(mod) coef(mod))
ses <- sapply(all_models, function(mod) sqrt(diag(vcov(mod))))

#Pool by RUbin's rules
pooled_results <- mi.meld(q = t(betas), se = t(ses)) # t means transposed - rows to columns

regression_table <- data.frame(
  Estimate = round(as.vector(pooled_results$q.mi), digits = 4),
  Std.Error = round(as.vector(pooled_results$se.mi), digits = 4)
) %>%
  mutate(t_value = round(Estimate/Std.Error, digits = 4),
         p_value = round(2 * (1- pnorm(abs(t_value))), digits = 4),
         z_95 = qnorm(0.975),
         lower_bound = Estimate - (z_95 * Std.Error),
         upper_bound = Estimate + (z_95 * Std.Error),
         row.names = colnames(pooled_results$q.mi)
         )


###marginal effects

pooled_marginal_effects <- as.data.frame(avg_comparisons(all_models, vcov = "HC3"))


results_3<- data.frame(
  estimate = round(regression_table$Estimate[2], digits = 2),
  Lower_95_CI = round(regression_table$lower_bound[2], digits = 2),
  Upper_95_CI = round(regression_table$upper_bound[2], digits = 2),
  raw_p_value = round(regression_table$p_value[2], digits = 3),
  marg_estimate <- round(pooled_marginal_effects$estimate[9], digits = 2),
  marg_Lower_95_CI = round(pooled_marginal_effects$conf.low[9], digits = 2),
  marg_Upper_95_CI = round(pooled_marginal_effects$conf.high[9], digits = 2),
  p_value = round(pooled_marginal_effects$p.value[9], digits = 3)
)

results_3 <- results_3 %>%
rename(marg_estimate = marg_estimate....round.pooled_marginal_effects.estimate.9...digits...2.)
print(results_3)

# > sd(as.numeric(!is.na(data_elig$crown_heel)))
# [1] 0.3118711
```

<!-- The data for this estimand includes randomised participants known to survive until 36.0 weeks PMA (n = 680). Of these participants, 35 were missing their standardised length Z-scores at 36.0 weeks PMA: 9 was withdrawn by 36 weeks PMA, 1 had their growth variables collected outside the 34-38 week window, 6 were discharged to secondary hospitals before 36.0 weeks PMA, and 27 did not have their length recorded at 36.0 week PMA, leaving 645 participants available for analysis. The length Z-scores of these 35 participants were imputed informed by prematurity strata and multiple birth status. -->

After adjustment for relevant covariates, the intervention group had a statistically significant mean difference of 0.20 in length Z-scores (SD from our cohort translate to cm) compared to the control group, translating to mean difference of approximately 0.062cm* longer than the control group within the cohort (marginal adjusted difference in means: 0.20, 95% CI: 0.05 to 0.35; B-H adjusted p-value = 0.007).

*0.20 x 0.31 (SD of the crown-heel length at 36.0wk PMA of the cohort)

# S8: BPD at $\leq$36.0 w PMA (logistic regression model)

Eligible and randomised participants present in the study at 36.0 weeks PMA. Participants with incomplete medical records up to 36.0 weeks PMA due to withdrawal or LTFU without evidence of BPD were excluded from analysis. Participants with incomplete medical records due to death within 36.0 weeks PMA will be included.

```{r data_S8 table, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

bpd_prepared <- data_elig %>%
  filter(wk36_present == 1 | death_36wpma == 1 | BPD_any == 1) %>% 
  mutate(
    rand_gp = factor(rand_gp, levels = c("0", "1"), labels = c("Control", "Intervention")),
    
    # Map numeric values (1 and 2) to your required strings
    ga_strata.f = case_when(
      ga_strata.f == "0" ~ "<28 weeks",
      ga_strata.f == "1" ~ "28-32 weeks",
      TRUE ~ as.character(ga_strata.f)
    ),
    ga_strata.f = factor(ga_strata.f, levels = c("<28 weeks", "28-32 weeks"))
  )

# 2. Create the stratified table (<28 weeks and 28-32 weeks)
tab_bpd_strata <- bpd_prepared %>%
  tbl_strata(
    strata = ga_strata.f,
    .tbl_fun = \(x) tbl_summary(
      x,
      include = BPD_any,
      by = rand_gp,
      percent = "column",
      statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n}/{N} ({p}%)"), 
      label = list(BPD_any ~ "BPD (Any)")
    ) 
  )

# 3. Create the overall table
tab_bpd_overall <- bpd_prepared %>%
  tbl_summary(
    include = BPD_any,
    by = rand_gp,
    percent = "column",
    statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n}/{N} ({p}%)"), 
    label = list(BPD_any ~ "BPD (Any)")
  ) %>%
  modify_spanning_header(all_stat_cols() ~ "**Overall**")

# 4. Merge side-by-side and add the Table Title
data_S8_tab <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(tab_bpd_strata, tab_bpd_overall),
  tab_spanner = FALSE 
) %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 3: Bronchopulmonary Dysplasia (BPD) by Prematurity Strata and Treatment Group**")

# 5. Print the table
data_S8_tab
```


```{r Estimand_S8, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

data_S8 <- data_elig %>%
  filter(wk36_present == 1 | death_36wpma == 1 | BPD_any == 1) %>%  #698 #3 missing
  dplyr::select(BPD_any, rand_gp, ga_strata.f, multiple, ans.factor, Birth_weight_Z, sex, recr_hosp.factor) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(BPD_any, rand_gp, ga_strata.f, multiple, ans.factor, Birth_weight_Z, sex) %>%
  add_rcs_splines(x_var = Birth_weight_Z, probs = c(0.1, 0.4, 0.6, 0.9))

fit_S8 <- glm(BPD_any ~ rand_gp + multiple + ans.factor + ga_strata.f + sex +
                        Birth_weight_Z1 + Birth_weight_Z2 + Birth_weight_Z3,
              data = data_S8, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

summary_fit <- summary(fit_S8)

S8_rr_marginal <- avg_comparisons(fit_S8, variables = "rand_gp", type = "response", transform = "exp", comparison = "lnratioavg", vcov = "HC3")


target_variable <- "rand_gp"
#don't adjust p_value
aRR <- exp(coef(fit_S8)["rand_gp"])
conf_int <- exp(confint(fit_S8, "rand_gp"))
cat("95% CI for difference:", conf_int[1], "to", conf_int[2], "\n")
raw_p_value_8 <- round(summary_fit$coefficients["rand_gp", "Pr(>|z|)"], digits = 3)
marg_RR <- S8_rr_marginal$estimate
marg_Lower_95_CI = S8_rr_marginal[,6]
marg_Upper_95_CI = S8_rr_marginal[,7]
p_value <- S8_rr_marginal$p.value


results_8 <- data.frame(
  #Parameter = target_variable,
  estimate = round(aRR, digits = 2),
  Lower_95_CI = round(conf_int[1], digits = 2),
  Upper_95_CI = round(conf_int[2], digits = 2),
  raw_p_value = raw_p_value_8,
  marg_estimate <- round(marg_RR, digits = 2),
  marg_Lower_95_CI = round(marg_Lower_95_CI, digits = 2),
  marg_Upper_95_CI = round(marg_Upper_95_CI, digits = 2),
  p_value = round(p_value, digits = 3)
)

results_8 <- results_8 %>%
  rename(marg_estimate = marg_estimate....round.marg_RR..digits...2.)

print(results_8)


#don't adjust p-value
```
<!-- The data for this estimand includes the randomised participants (N = 744). 44 participants were missing data and excluded for this outcome.34 had withdrawn without evidence of BPD, 1 participant had been discharged to a non-participating hospital without evidence of BPD and 1 participant was missing this data altogether. -->

There was insufficient evidence to detect a significant difference in the risk of any BPD between the control and the intervention groups (marginal adjusted risk ratio 0.89, 95% CI: 0.75 to 1.06; p-value = 0.204).

# S14 Necrotising enterocolitis (NEC) Stage II or greater prior to discharge home or 44.0 weeks PMA, whichever occurs sooner

Eligible and randomised participants know to survive to 44.0 weeks PMA. Participants who have withdrawn and LTFU prior to discharge from hospital were excluded from analysis, unless there is evidence of NEC Stage II or greater. Participants with incomplete medical records due to death within 44.0 weeks PMA are included.

```{r  nec_2 table, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

data_prep <- data_elig %>%
  filter(wk44_present == 1 | death_44wpma == 1 | nec_2 == 1) %>% #554
  mutate(
    rand_gp = factor(rand_gp, levels = c("0", "1"), labels = c("Control", "Intervention")),
    nec_2.f = factor(nec_2, levels = c("0", "1"), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
  )

make_summary <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    tbl_summary(
      include = nec_2.f,
      by = rand_gp,
      percent = "column",
      statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n}/{N} ({p}%)"), 
      label = list(nec_2.f ~ "NEC >Stage 2")
    )
}

table_s1      <- data_prep %>% filter(ga_strata == "1") %>% make_summary()
table_s2      <- data_prep %>% filter(ga_strata == "2") %>% make_summary()
table_overall <- data_prep %>% make_summary()

# 4. Merge them side-by-side with distinct headers
data_S14_table <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(table_s1, table_s2, table_overall),
  tab_spanner = c("**<28 weeks**", "**28-<32 weeks**", "**Overall**")
) %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 14: NEC >Stage 2 by Prematurity Strata and Treatment Group**")


# 5. Print the table
data_S14_table
```

```{r Estimand_S14, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
## the diagnosis of NEC stage IIb or more on Bells classification, amended to NEC Stage II or greater
#prior to initial discharge home or 44 w PMA, whichever occurs sooner.****
##does not require the 44wk filter

data_S14 <- data_elig %>% #554
  dplyr::select(nec_2,study_id,rand_gp, ga_strata.f, multiple, ans.factor, Birth_weight_Z, sex, recr_hosp.factor) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(rand_gp, ga_strata.f, multiple, ans.factor, Birth_weight_Z, sex,recr_hosp.factor) %>%
  #dplyr::select(where(~ any(is.na(.))))
  add_rcs_splines(x_var = Birth_weight_Z, probs = c(0.1, 0.4, 0.6, 0.9))

fit_S14 <- glm(nec_2 ~ rand_gp + multiple + ans.factor + ga_strata.f + sex +
                           Birth_weight_Z1 + Birth_weight_Z2 + Birth_weight_Z3,
              data = data_S14, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

summary_fit <- summary(fit_S14) #Odds ratio


S14_rr_marginal <- avg_comparisons(fit_S14, variables = "rand_gp", type = "response", transform = "exp", comparison = "lnratioavg", vcov = "HC3")


target_variable <- "rand_gp"
#don't adjust p_value
aRR <- exp(coef(fit_S14)["rand_gp"])
conf_int <- exp(confint(fit_S14, "rand_gp"))
cat("95% CI for difference:", conf_int[1], "to", conf_int[2], "\n")
raw_p_value_14 <- round(summary_fit$coefficients["rand_gp", "Pr(>|z|)"], digits = 3)
marg_RR <- S14_rr_marginal$estimate
marg_Lower_95_CI = S14_rr_marginal[,6]
marg_Upper_95_CI = S14_rr_marginal[,7]
p_value <- S14_rr_marginal$p.value


results_14 <- data.frame(
 #Parameter = target_variable,
  estimate = round(aRR, digits = 2),
  Lower_95_CI = round(conf_int[1], digits = 2),
  Upper_95_CI = round(conf_int[2], digits = 2),
  raw_p_value = raw_p_value_14,
  marg_estimate <- round(marg_RR, digits = 2),
  marg_Lower_95_CI = round(marg_Lower_95_CI, digits = 2),
  marg_Upper_95_CI = round(marg_Upper_95_CI, digits = 2),
  p_value = round(p_value, digits = 3)
)

results_14 <- results_14 %>%
  rename(marg_estimate = marg_estimate....round.marg_RR..digits...2.)

print(results_14)


#don't adjust p-value
```
<!-- The data for this estimand included the randomised and eligible participants who have been discharged home or known to survive until 44.0 weeks PMA, whichever occurs sooner (N = 744). No participants had data missing for this outcome in this cohort. -->

There was a difference in risk of NEC Stage II or greater between the intervention and control groups (marginal adjusted risk ratio 0.30, 95%CI: 0.12 to 0.73, p-value = 0.008).

# S18: Number of culture-positive sepsis episodes for participants who survive to 44.0wk PMA (Poisson regression model)

```{r  S-18 table, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
###

data_prepared <- data_elig %>%
  filter(wk44_present == 1 | death_44wpma == 1) %>% #550
  mutate(
    rand_gp = factor(rand_gp, levels = c("0", "1"), labels = c("Control", "Intervention")),
    sepsis_count.f = as.factor(sepsis_count)
  )

# 2. Create the stratified table (Strata 1 & Strata 2)
# Using `all_stat_cols() ~ "**{level}**<br>N = {n}"` here forces the true cell group sample sizes.
tab_strata <- data_prepared %>%
  tbl_strata(
    strata = ga_strata.f,
    .tbl_fun = \(x) tbl_summary(
      x,
      include = c(sepsis_count.f, sepsis_count),
      by = rand_gp,
      percent = "column",
      statistic = list(
        all_categorical() ~ "{n}/{N} ({p}%)",
        all_continuous()  ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})"
      ),
      label = list(
        sepsis_count.f ~ "No. of episodes",
        sepsis_count ~ "Overall"
      )
    ) %>% 
      modify_header(all_stat_cols() ~ "**{level}**<br>N = {n}") 
  )

# 3. Create the Overall table (with matching N assignment logic)
tab_overall <- data_prepared %>%
  tbl_summary(
    include = c(sepsis_count.f, sepsis_count),
    by = rand_gp,
    percent = "column",
    statistic = list(
      all_categorical() ~ "{n}/{N} ({p}%)",
      all_continuous()  ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})"
    ),
    label = list(
      sepsis_count.f ~ "No. of episodes",
      sepsis_count ~ "Overall"
    )
  ) %>% 
  modify_header(all_stat_cols() ~ "**{level}**<br>N = {n}")

# 4. Merge and assign explicit spanning headers
# Since the bottom headers are already dynamically baked in, we only handle the macro blocks here.
data_S18_tab <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(tab_strata, tab_overall) 
) %>%
  modify_spanning_header(
    c(stat_1_1_1, stat_2_1_1) ~ "**Strata 1**",
    c(stat_1_2_1, stat_2_2_1) ~ "**Strata 2**",
    c(stat_1_2, stat_2_2)     ~ "**Overall**"
  ) %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 1. Patient Characteristics Stratified by Group and Overall Cohort**")

# View the final table
data_S18_tab
```



```{r Estimand_S18, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
## number of culture-positive sepsis episodes for participants who survive to 44.0 w PMA****

#Fit Poisson regression model - rate ratio

data_S18 <- data_elig %>%
  filter(wk44_present == 1 | death_44wpma == 1) %>% #550
  dplyr::select(study_id,sepsis_count, rand_gp, ga_strata.f, multiple, ans.factor, Birth_weight_Z, sex, recr_hosp.factor) %>% 
  tidyr::drop_na(sepsis_count, rand_gp, ga_strata.f, multiple, ans.factor, Birth_weight_Z, sex) %>%
  #dplyr::select(where(~ any(is.na(.))))# 
  add_rcs_splines(x_var = Birth_weight_Z, probs = c(0.1, 0.4, 0.6, 0.9))


fit_S18p <- glm(sepsis_count ~ rand_gp + multiple + ans.factor + ga_strata.f + sex + recr_hosp.factor +
                               Birth_weight_Z1 + Birth_weight_Z2 + Birth_weight_Z3,
                family = poisson(link="log"), data = data_S18)

dispersiontest(fit_S18p) #AER package: Cameron_Trivedi test - where variance exceeds mean

#Overdispersion test

# data:  fit_S18p
# z = 1.4668, p-value = 0.07122
# alternative hypothesis: true dispersion is greater than 1
# sample estimates:
# dispersion 
#   1.598843 
# 1. dispersion estimate (α or c): This is the calculated dispersion parameter.
# 	• In a perfect Poisson model, this value is 1.0 (equidispersion).
# 	• A value greater than 1 (e.g., 1.42) indicates the variance grows faster than the mean, signaling overdispersion.
# 2. p-value: This evaluates the null hypothesis that your data is equidistributed.
# 	• If p < 0.05: Reject the null hypothesis. You have statistically significant overdispersion. A standard Poisson model will yield over-optimistic, artificially narrow confidence intervals and incorrect standard errors.
# 	• If p ≥ 0.05: Fail to reject the null hypothesis. Your Poisson model's distributional assumptions are fine to use.

# fit_S18p_nb <- glm.nb(sepsis_count ~ rand_gp + multiple + ans.factor + ga_strata.f + sex + recr_hosp.factor +
#                        Birth_weight_Z1 + Birth_weight_Z2 + Birth_weight_Z3,  
#                      data = data_S18)
# 
# # 3. View the model summary
# summary(fit_S18p_nb)

S18p_rr_marginal <- avg_comparisons(fit_S18p, variables = "rand_gp", transform = "exp", comparison = "lnratioavg", vcov = "HC3" )

# Model summary
summary_fit <- summary(fit_S18p)
raw_p_value_18 <- round(summary_fit$coefficients["rand_gp", "Pr(>|z|)"], digits = 3)

# --- Extract coefficient for 'groupB' ---
coef_name <- "rand_gp"
se_value <- sqrt(vcov(fit_S18p)[coef_name, coef_name])  # standard error

# Calculate Relative Risk (RR) and 95% CI
aRateRatio <- round(exp(coef(fit_S18p)[coef_name]), 2)
conf_int <- round(exp(confint(fit_S18p, "rand_gp")), 2)
cat("95% CI for difference:", conf_int[1], "to", conf_int[2], "\n")
marg_RateRatio <- round(S18p_rr_marginal$estimate, 2)
marg_Lower_95_CI = round(S18p_rr_marginal[,6], 2)
marg_Upper_95_CI = round(S18p_rr_marginal[,7], 2)
p_value <- round(S18p_rr_marginal$p.value, 3)


results_18 <- data.frame(
  #Outcome = dth_yn,
  estimate = aRateRatio,
  Lower_95_CI = conf_int[1],
  Upper_95_CI = conf_int[2],
  raw_p_value = raw_p_value_18,
  marg_estimate = marg_RateRatio,
  marg_Lower_95_CI = marg_Lower_95_CI,
  marg_Upper_95_CI = marg_Upper_95_CI,
  p_value = p_value
)

print(results_18)

#don't adjust p-value
```
<!-- This estimand included the participants who were known to be alive at 44.0 wk PMA (n = 530). There was 1 participant with missing data for this outcome and were excluded leaving 529 participants available for analysis. -->

There was insufficient evidence to conclude a significant difference in the adjusted rate of number of sepsis episodes between the intervention and control groups (marginal adjusted rate ratio 0.94, 95% CI: 0.44 to 2.03, p-value = 0.877.
